items.prompt: Why do strict warnings, reference tests, range proofs and sanitizers all remain useful after one clean run?
items.modelAnswer: They cover different failure classes and scopes: static diagnostics, expected business/value behavior, mathematical preconditions and selected dynamic operations. A finite clean run misses unexecuted cases and semantic/provenance/concurrency conditions. Record exact evidence without treating tools as universal certification.
